_comment: CAS garbage-collection limits used by scripts/cas-merkle-store.cjs. Every value here can be overridden per-deployment via env vars without editing this file: CAS_GC_ENABLED, CAS_GC_KEEP_SNAPSHOTS, CAS_GC_EMERGENCY_KEEP_SNAPSHOTS, CAS_GC_WARN_GB (or CAS_GC_WARN_BYTES), CAS_GC_AUTO_GB (or CAS_GC_AUTO_BYTES), CAS_GC_EMERGENCY_GB (or CAS_GC_EMERGENCY_BYTES), CAS_GC_BLOCK_ON_EMERGENCY. See .env.example.
